findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "list_niches" is 9539 chars, far longer than this server's median (1004). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "place_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: 🔴 ACTS FOR THE USER: call it only after the user has explicitly agreed to this exact action (what, where, when, who) — never on your own judgement. For a busin…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "catalog" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: place_order · Private data: request_to_owner · Public sink: list_niches, place_order, request_to_owner.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: place_order · Private data: request_to_owner · Public sink: list_niches, place_order, request_to_owner

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
